description: SINGLE-SOURCE CANONICAL TOOL REGISTRY for arifOS MCP kernel.
doctrine: THIS file is the source of truth. Every other tool list (capability_registry.json, constitutional_map.CANONICAL_TOOLS, public_surface.py) MUST be derived from or validated against this file. If this file says a tool is public, the runtime MUST expose it. If internal, the runtime MUST NOT expose it. Drift = 888_HOLD.

arif_init.description: Session ignition — binds actor, floors, and audit for governed operations.
arif_init.constitutional_requirement: F1: irreversible ack required for epoch operations

arif_observe.description: Sense reality into evidence with epistemic tags and uncertainty bounds.
arif_observe.constitutional_requirement: F2: accuracy >= 0.99 or declare uncertainty. F7: Omega in [0.03, 0.05]

arif_think.description: Structured reasoning under F2/F7 with OBS/DER/INT/SPEC labels.
arif_think.constitutional_requirement: F9: C_dark < 0.30. F2: tau >= 0.99. F10: no soul/feelings claims

arif_memory.description: Memory governor — L1-L6 governed semantic recall, storage, and persistence.
arif_memory.constitutional_requirement: L01: reversible-first. L11: verify identity before sensitive ops

arif_judge.constitutional_requirement: L13: human veto absolute. F1: Amanah reversibility

arif_forge.description: Execution gate via A-FORGE — mutates only after SEAL verdict.
arif_forge.constitutional_requirement: L13: human veto. L01: reversible-first unless ack_irreversible

arif_seal.description: VAULT999 immutable append — irreversible civilizational memory sealing.
arif_seal.constitutional_requirement: Irreversible. F1: explicit human ack required. L13: sovereign authority

arif_kernel_intercept.description: Minimum constitutional kernel interceptor for agent actions.
arif_kernel_intercept.access_reason: Kernel-internal intercept spine — not a user-facing tool

arif_critique.description: Ethical/dignity/risk stress test before judgment (absorbed into arif_think mode=critique).

arif_compose.description: Final human-facing composition with citations and tone control.
arif_compose.access_reason: Composition belongs on ChatGPT/client adapter or private SDK, not top-level sovereign capability. Absorbed into arif_forge(mode=compose).

arif_triage.access_reason: Absorbed into arif_init modes per ZEN-9 2026-07-09

arif_fetch.description: Targeted URL/source retrieval with provenance tracking.

arif_bridge_connect.description: Low-level organ bridge call requiring session and lease.

arif_measure.access_reason: Internal support tool — not a public capability

arif_session_init.migration: Call arif_init directly — no wrapper needed

arif_compose.migration: Composition is private/internal. Use arif_forge(mode='compose') for SDK usage.
arif_compose.doctrine: Composition (formatting/tone/summarisation) belongs on ChatGPT/client adapter or private SDK, not top-level sovereign capability. See surface-conformance gate.

arif_reply_compose.migration: Composition is forge mode. Use arif_forge(mode='compose').

arifos_init.migration: Use arif_init — arifos_ prefix is blocked on public surface

public_agent.notes: Public agents see 4 tools by default. memory/judge/forge/seal require authentication or escalation.

trusted_agent.notes: Trusted agents get memory + judge. Forge and seal require executor or sovereign profile.

executor.notes: Executors can forge (execute) but cannot seal. Sovereign escalates for seal.

sovereign.notes: Full 8-tool public surface. Sovereign can access all canonical tools.

operator.notes: Operator profile = sovereign + diagnostics. Full surface with diagnostic tools.

semantic_abi.assertion: semantic_tool_names() must match public_tools keys exactly

surface_doctrine.charter: The arifOS MCP surface is a governed constitutional facade. Every public tool is a constitutional organ. Every internal tool is accounted for. Drift between registry contract and runtime exposure is a deployment-blocking condition (888_HOLD).
rules: public_tools MUST be registered on FastMCP and listed in tools/list
internal_tools MUST NOT appear on any public tools/list response
SDK aliases may appear on the wire for legacy compat but MUST redirect with _redirect_to metadata
diagnostic_tools MUST only appear when ARIFOS_MCP_EXPOSE_DEV_TOOLS=true
Every tool in tools/list MUST be callable — no phantom registrations
Every public canonical tool MUST be callable by its registered name with no additional auth for OBSERVE actions
Internal tools MUST fail-closed with HOLD when called via public wire
888_hold_triggers: public_tool in registry but NOT in runtime tools/list
runtime tool in tools/list but NOT registered as public in registry (unless diagnostic+gated)
SDK alias appears as a standalone tool instead of redirecting
